source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Say, O Messenger, to those who disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger: O disbelievers in Allah!
tafsir.muyassar-2: I do not worship what you worship of idols and false gods.
tafsir.muyassar-3: Nor will you worship what I worship — the One God, Allah, Lord of the worlds, Who alone deserves worship.
tafsir.muyassar-4: Nor do I worship what you have worshipped of idols and false gods.
tafsir.muyassar-5: Nor will you, in the future, worship what I worship. This verse was revealed about specific individuals among the polytheists whom Allah knew would never believe.
tafsir.muyassar-6: You have your religion, which you insisted on following, and I have my religion, which I seek no other than.
